# Majorsilence Reporting

> Open-source .NET reporting framework (formerly My-FyiReporting) for building, rendering, and viewing RDL-based reports — a self-hosted alternative to SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Crystal Reports. Targets .NET 8 and .NET 10; the core engine runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows, with a Windows-only WinForms drag-and-drop designer and viewer.

Majorsilence Reporting lets developers generate reports two ways: programmatically, via a fluent C# API (`Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCreator`) or by parsing an existing `.rdl` report definition (`Majorsilence.Reporting.Rdl`), or visually, with a Windows drag-and-drop designer. Reports render to PDF and other output formats, pulling data from providers including SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Firebird, and JSON. Licensed Apache 2.0 (select sub-projects are additionally tri-licensed MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD-2-Clause).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/majorsilence/Reporting/blob/main/Readme.md): install instructions, quick-start code samples, license and build status
- [Wiki](https://github.com/majorsilence/My-FyiReporting/wiki): full documentation home
- [Database Providers Howto](https://github.com/majorsilence/My-FyiReporting/wiki/Database-Providers-Howto): connecting reports to a data source
- [Downloads](https://github.com/majorsilence/My-FyiReporting/wiki/Downloads): prebuilt designer/viewer downloads
- [Contribute](https://github.com/majorsilence/My-FyiReporting/wiki/Contribute): contribution workflow
- [Specification](https://github.com/majorsilence/Reporting/blob/main/Specification.md): the RDL report-definition format this project implements

## Packages

- [Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlEngine.SkiaSharp](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlEngine.SkiaSharp/): core RDL parsing and rendering engine
- [Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCreator.SkiaSharp](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCreator.SkiaSharp/): fluent C# API for building RDL reports programmatically
- [Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCri.SkiaSharp](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Majorsilence.Reporting.RdlCri.SkiaSharp/): CustomReportItem (CRI) extension library for RDL reports
